products: St. John's wort oral dietary supplement
preservation: Ingredient-level supplement identities do not authenticate a brand, extract, plant part, preparation, purity, potency, combination product, dose, schedule, indication, or availability.
Proprietary blends and nonspecific herbal-supplement inputs remain unresolved and fail closed.

Bleeding, clotting, glucose, serotonergic and other drug interactions, sedation burden, chronic-use withdrawal context, hepatic status, procedure risk, and local policy remain accountable clinician/pharmacy/anesthesia/procedural-team review.

Fish oil was not added to special-handling rules because broad omega-3 evidence does not support generalized increased bleeding; high-dose purified EPA cannot be generalized to unspecified supplements.
No continuation, interruption, taper, restart, hold interval, substitution, dosing, administration, anesthesia, or procedural timing is authorized.

identities: self-reported oral or edible cannabis use pattern
preservation: Self-reported cannabis use patterns are reconciliation concepts, not authenticated products; route, ingredients, potency, purity, dose, frequency, duration, and recency remain unresolved unless explicitly documented.
Bare cannabis and marijuana inputs are deliberately ambiguous across inhaled and oral use patterns; THC, CBD, cannabinoid oil, and unclear mixtures remain unresolved.
Consumer CBD is not inferred to be EPIDIOLEX, and MARINOL capsule and SYNDROS solution remain distinct non-interchangeable whole-product identities.

Cognition or acute-intoxication context, hemodynamic/cardiovascular effects, inhaled airway/respiratory effects, sedation/anesthetic interaction, hepatic and interacting-medication context, withdrawal, and postoperative pain/nausea remain accountable review questions.
No continuation, interruption, taper, restart, hold interval, substitution, route/form conversion, dosing, anesthesia plan, or procedural timing is authorized.
